chapter: California, Cats and the Fiddle, the Tatum trio
title: Learning the Cats and the Fiddle repertoire and arranging
summary: He had to memorize twenty or thirty songs and vocal parts quickly and did much of the arranging, such as Blue Skies.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: You had to have a pretty strong brain to remember. Everything was remembered. There was no reading. They had all this singing, all the parts, we would rehearse, and I had to learn about 20 or 30 songs when I first joined them in order to get by. So we would rehearse about a week and I got enough songs for us to get going and bit by bit after awhile I knew everything they knew. Plus I did a lot of the arranging. They got a little bit more on the musical side, I'd say. Like I arranged Blue Skies...
